title: My Morning Routine
paragraph: I wake up at seven every morning. First, I drink a glass of water and open the window. Then I brush my teeth and make a cup of tea. I like to eat toast with butter and a little jam. After breakfast, I pack my bag and walk to the bus stop. It is a calm and happy start to my day.

title: A Day at the Park
paragraph: On Sunday, we went to the park near our house. The sun was bright and the sky was blue. My little brother played on the swings, and I sat under a big tree. We ate sandwiches and drank cold juice. A small dog ran past us, and everyone laughed. It was a lovely day.
tongue_twisters: Sam sat in the sunny park.
Little Lily likes the long, low swing.

title: My Best Friend
paragraph: My best friend is called Ben. We met at school when we were seven years old. He is kind, funny, and always ready to help. We both love football and cheese pizza. On weekends, we play games at his house or ride our bikes. I am lucky to have a friend like him.
tongue_twisters: Pat picks pink pizza for Paul.

title: Rainy Day
paragraph: Today it is raining, so I am staying at home. I put on my warm socks and make hot chocolate. The rain taps softly on the window. I sit on the sofa with a good book and a soft blanket. Sometimes a rainy day is the best kind of day.
tongue_twisters: Warm socks stay soft and snug.
Hot cocoa helps Holly happily hide.

title: At the Market
paragraph: Every Friday, I go to the market with my mother. We buy fresh fruit, green vegetables, and brown eggs. The seller always smiles and says hello. I carry the bag of apples, and my mother holds the list. We say thank you and walk home slowly. I love the colors and sounds of the market.

title: My Pet Cat
paragraph: I have a small grey cat named Luna. She sleeps on my bed and wakes me up in the morning. Luna loves to play with a red ball and drink milk from a blue bowl. When I come home from school, she runs to the door. She is soft, quiet, and very sweet. I love her very much.
tongue_twisters: The cat caught a cute, cuddly kitten.
Soft, sleepy, silver Sally sits still.

title: Cooking with Dad
paragraph: On Saturday, I cook lunch with my dad. First, we wash the rice and cut the onions. Then he fries the chicken, and I stir the soup. The kitchen smells wonderful. We set the table together and call everyone to eat. Food always tastes better when we make it ourselves.
tongue_twisters: Cook the chicken, then check the rice.

title: The School Bus
paragraph: Every day, the yellow school bus comes at eight o'clock. I wait at the corner with my friends. We talk about homework, games, and funny videos. The driver, Mr. Khan, says good morning to everyone. Sometimes we sing a song on the way. The ride is short, but it is always fun.
tongue_twisters: Bus number nine is on time.
Mr. Khan makes many mornings merry.
Six school kids sing silly songs.

title: A Trip to the Beach
paragraph: Last summer, we drove to the beach for a holiday. The sand was warm and the water was cool. I built a big sandcastle, and my sister collected shells. We ate ice cream and watched the waves roll in. When the sun went down, the sky turned pink and orange. I will never forget that day.
tongue_twisters: Seven small shells sit by the sea.

title: Before Bedtime
paragraph: At night, I turn off the lights and get into bed. My mother reads me a short story about a little rabbit. The room is quiet, and the moon shines through the window. I close my eyes and think about my day. Soon, I am fast asleep and dreaming of green fields.
tongue_twisters: Little rabbits rest in their room.
Sleepy Sue sings a soft song.
